description_html:
Overview

The product contains all the non-3D printed parts for assembling various functional Flexi Pets Keychain & Magnet Collections. To complete the work, you also need to download the Compatible model files and  3D print the remaining parts.

Creator Program: The Creator Program is a collaborative program between Bambu Lab and creators. Creators unleash their creativity to design 3D printing models, while Bambu Lab provides compatible hardware kits for those designs.
